note: A teaching card for TR-03. It is not an FCC publication and not a substitute for Part 97. Confirm the current rules before you transmit. Numbers here are the limits the lab asks you to look up.

hfPhone.note: Technician HF phone in this card is 28.300 through 28.500 MHz. A signal has width, so the exact edge is a poor center frequency.

secondary: Do not cause harmful interference to the primary service, and accept interference from it.
groupD: Two letters, one digit, three letters. That format is the Group D shape used for a sequential Technician call sign in this card.
identification: English, your FCC call sign, at least every 10 minutes and at the end. A tactical name does not replace it.
